title: Voices from the Gate
text: Every night now the Rift Gate speaks one House's name, in the voices of its own dead. Last night it spoke yours. It is offering something, the old women say: a gift for a House brave enough to walk up to the Gate and listen to the end.

options.label: Send a Scion to listen at the Gate.

outcomes.text: Your Scion listens to the end. The voices give them a gift, cold and heavy, and a message they will only repeat in their sleep.
Your Scion listens past the end. They come back answering to their grandmother's name.

options.label: Answer it, from the walls, with the Pact's words.

outcomes.text: Your Scions shout the Pact's oath back at the Gate all night. By dawn their voices are gone, and so are the Gate's.
You hear nothing. The Gate speaks your name every night for a month, and then, worse, stops.
